name: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault
description: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter game and the third in the Medal of Honor series.

gog.store_details: Sold as the 'War Chest' edition — the base game plus the Spearhead and Breakthrough expansions.

notes: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault GOG release ships only the software Miles provider, so EAX can't be turned on without adding the missing provider files.
